decisions.reason: As a semi-hard cheese wheel close to the firm's established cheese capabilities, it fits existing knowledge and supply relations well, so despite no visible strong R&D base the firm would more likely refine and retain it than withdraw it.

Because this spicy cheese line builds directly on the firm's core cheese expertise and was expanded into several variants, management is likely to see enough related knowledge and commitment to keep it on the market.

This mild creamy soft cheese extends the firm's existing soft-cheese offer in a familiar direction, so absorptive capacity is high enough that the firm would probably continue it, though limited visible research activity leaves some withdrawal risk.
